metadata.title: Ensemble Variance Monitor (EVM) — Prediction Uncertainty Report
metadata.description: Measures the Student model's prediction uncertainty using six calibrated metrics. All metrics are normalized to [0, 1]. This report is a direct upstream input to SCRS.

normalization_notes.predictive_entropy: Shannon entropy H(p) = -sum_v p_v*log(p_v), normalized by log(vocab_size) to [0, 1]. Value 1 = maximum uncertainty (uniform distribution). Value 0 = maximum confidence (degenerate distribution).
normalization_notes.top1_confidence: Maximum probability max_v p_v. Native probability in [0, 1]. Value 1 = model places all mass on one token. Value 0 = model places essentially no mass on any single token.
normalization_notes.top5_confidence_spread: Difference p_(1) - p_(5) between rank-1 and rank-5 probabilities. Both are probabilities so difference is in [0, 1]. Large value = mass concentrated at top. Small value = flat distribution.
normalization_notes.probability_variance: Sample variance of top-k probabilities, normalized by the theoretical maximum variance (1/k)(1-1/k) for a k-item distribution. Range [0, 1]. High value = peaked/confident. Low value = flat/uncertain.
normalization_notes.confidence_margin: Difference p_(1) - p_(2) between rank-1 and rank-2 probabilities. Both are probabilities so difference is in [0, 1]. Large margin = model strongly prefers one token. Near zero = confusion.
normalization_notes.mc_dropout_consistency: Fraction of MC Dropout passes agreeing with the majority-vote prediction, averaged over token positions. Range [0, 1]. Value 1 = all passes agree (stable). Value 0 = all passes disagree (unstable).
